description: This source file implements the ConsulBasedMembershipTable class, which provides an Orleans IMembershipTable implementation using Consul for cluster member management, including methods for reading, inserting, updating, deleting, and cleaning up silo registration data.

classes.name: ConsulBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements Orleans IMembershipTable using Consul, managing silo registration records, membership data synchronization with Consul KV store, and cleanup operations.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table; in this case, a no-op as Consul does not support extended Membership Protocol TableVersion.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads the membership data for a specific silo address from Consul.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all silo registration entries from Consul and assembles membership data.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new silo membership record into Consul; performs a Compare-And-Swap (CAS) operation.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing silo registration, verifying with CAS using the specified ETag.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a silo registration in Consul.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a specified cluster from Consul.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes silo entries that are outdated and not active based on a timestamp threshold.
